context.content: I'm pretty close with my sisters boy 17yo he grew up down the street and i used to take care of him many times even lived with me while his parents were out of state for a month. Thought he was straight but at mother's day he was more chatty with me than usual about me and my bf. I get a text last week he wants to know what Dr I go to. I asked the usual things like is everything OK and he said maybe something bad happened. He starting texting about gay sex and I called him so I could hear his voice to figure out what was going on. Him and his best friend have been sucking each other for a year now he has a really sore throat thinks maybe from that. His parents are pretty religious and I see why he chose me. I took him to the gay clinic by my house he got tested for everything and has strep. Nbd I paid for everything. But now he has to hide the meds. I know he came to me because I won't judge him and I know about gay sex. I felt stupid for asking him why he's having sex with his friend he just shrugged and said just something to do (Gen Z you're killing me). The big issue is now I have a secret from my sister and entire family. It likely will all come out one day in the future and I'll be the bad guy. Anyone have to keep secrets from the family?
